interface.longDescription: Use a provider-neutral workflow to generate realistic AI speech with playback and named audio-file resources across ElevenLabs, Hume, Cartesia, Resemble AI, OpenAI, Deepgram, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, and Microsoft Azure Speech. Compatible hosts can present those resources as downloads. VoxBridge selects provider-specific controls without forcing users to learn eight APIs.
